transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify its session closed; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.source_checkpoint: 9972307 + corrected Windows runner build verified by operator; metadata recovery only afterward
build.identity_note: Corrected runner built with zero warnings/errors; adapter/transform/encoder selftests passed; staged C# client then passed against the real read-only Day1 Host /v1/status contract with status_has_ok_field=false. session.shape: The Host profile keeps its permanent 40 ms floor. The adapter separately enforces a 90 ms client dispatch cadence and waits for each prior ACK. Keeping these distinct avoids the earlier 83 ms floor/cadence trap and preserves arrival-time margin without changing the Host profile.

stream.source_description: NexiGo VID_0C45 PID_2690 live camera; WinRT Realtime freshest-frame slots; fixed srgb_area transform and deterministic 255-colour guard

live_source.producer_description: Windows-native camera/transform/encoder + typed-session adapter. The exact source and W6-passing Windows Release build are frozen below; Windows-local staging/selftests, nonce negative control and five-minute real-camera soak all passed.

camera.observed_rate_exception: Exposure-quantised 30 fps previously measured; see route section 11. Re-measure in trial preflight, do not promise 60 fps.

transform.palette_guard: closest weighted-colour pair, deterministic scan-order tie break, applied last

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

budgets.derivation: min(floor(10000 / 90) + 1, 500) = 112 frames; 112 * 3 = 336 packets; canonical encoder worst-case is 1054 application bytes including both preambles, so 112 * 1054 = 118048 bytes.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
malformed or unexpected report / canvas invalidation / stock takeover
10 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, allow an already-submitted frame to settle, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: bounded clean close; zero retries, reconnects, pacing refusals or encoder-hash mismatches; queue depth at most one
acceptance.visual: owner judges face/hand recognizability and orientation; W2 seven-scene ranking remains outstanding
acceptance.latency: report measured source age and ACK timing separately; do not claim optical latency from an ACK
